result.summary: The image shows a multi-lane residential thoroughfare with marked zebra crosswalks and a grass median. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide crossing distance and lack of pedestrian-activated signals or refuge protection increase risk.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Multi-lane Crossing
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without the protection of a signal or stop sign, increasing the risk of multiple-threat crashes.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center crossing the main roadway

hazards.name: Wet Road Surface
hazards.description: The wet pavement increases vehicle braking distances and reduces visibility of lane markings.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at this uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Enhance the existing median with a raised concrete refuge area and 'cut-through' to provide a safe waiting space mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane area to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks and signals. However, the long crossing distances and car-centric design create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians, exacerbated by wet road conditions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway on the left.

hazards.name: Wet Road Surface
hazards.description: Rainy conditions reduce vehicle braking efficiency and pedestrian visibility.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radius
hazards.description: The geometry of the right turn lane allows for higher vehicle speeds during turns.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the median to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features an extremely wide multi-lane roadway with no visible pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or signals. This design creates a hostile environment for pedestrians due to long exposure times and a lack of dedicated safety features at a signalized junction.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide multi-lane road without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without guidance or protection.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals to provide clear information on when it is safe to cross and how much time remains.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with significant crossing distances and worn pavement markings. While traffic signals and a small refuge island are present, the environment lacks robust pedestrian protection and high-visibility crossing infrastructure.
